items.quote: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.
items.contrast: Whether “them” refers to the towers Uzziah built or to the nearby gates.
items.reason: The gates are a plausible distraction because they are nearby plural nouns, but “at” identifies them as locations. The direct object of “built” is “towers,” so “fortified them” refers to the towers.
